title: Optokinetic Measurements of Visual Acuity and Contrast Sensitivity
author: David A. Antonetti
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x99fr96

steps.title: Set up the optokinetic environment
steps.instruction: Place the animal unrestrained on a platform in the center of a square box formed by four computer monitors.

substeps.instruction: Display a rotating cylinder comprised of a vertical sine wave grating, calculated and drawn in virtual three-dimensional coordinate space, on the monitors.

steps.title: Track head movement and maintain focus
steps.instruction: Monitor the animal for reflexive head and neck movements in response to the rotating grating.

substeps.instruction: Repeatedly re-center the cylinder on the animal's head in real time to clamp the spatial frequency of the grating at the viewing position.

steps.title: Quantify visual acuity
steps.instruction: Determine visual acuity by incrementally increasing the spatial frequency of the grating until an optomotor response can no longer be elicited.

steps.title: Measure contrast sensitivity
steps.instruction: Identify the minimum contrast that generates tracking across a range of spatial frequencies.
